visual.title: Arrows point toward a stable equilibrium
visual.caption: The phase line draws the sign of x prime. Where the arrow points toward an equilibrium, nearby solutions approach it. The exponential decay equation has a single stable equilibrium at zero.

predict.question: For x prime equals minus x, what happens to a solution that starts near zero?
options: It stays exactly at zero unless it starts there
predict.explain: The slope is negative for positive x and positive for negative x. Both sides point toward zero, so the equilibrium is stable.
